importantFindings: Beneteau Antares 9 is not one continuous 2018-current hull: the 2018–24 generation is 9.12 m LOA while the new 2025 generation is 8.23 m. B-Atlas now stores two canonical generations.
Beneteau Swift Trawler 48 and 52 manufacturer pages contain internally inconsistent imperial/metric displacement values. Canonical values use the metric figures and preserve the conflicts.
Jeanneau Merry Fisher 635 regional pages disagree on draft/weight; B-Atlas follows the global model page and stores the US-page difference as conflicting evidence.
Jeanneau Merry Fisher 795 receives generation-scoped dimensions because earlier/current official pages show different LOA/draft values.
Cruisers 3260 and 3270 Esprit were incorrectly combined. They share exterior styling but have materially different interiors and drivetrain details, so they are now separate canonical models.
Cruisers 288→298→2980, 3275→320, 3470→340, 3650→3750→375 and 3870 Esprit→Express are handled as marketing-name production phases.
Cruisers 390 Sports Coupe supports V-drive and IPS propulsion, so model-wide propulsion is intentionally unresolved.
